lines.zh: 我沿着营墙巡逻，脚步压得很轻。
lines.en: I walk the camp wall with my steps kept soft.

lines.zh: 轻甲不碍事，我能绕哨塔走三圈。
lines.en: Light armor lets me lap the watchtower three times.

lines.zh: 剑挂在腰侧，走一步磕一下。
lines.en: My sword knocks against my hip with every step.

lines.zh: 换岗了，我小跑着去接替同伴。
lines.en: Shift change; I jog over to relieve my comrade.

lines.zh: 靴底碾过碎石，藏不住动静。
lines.en: Gravel crunches under my boots; no hiding that.

lines.zh: 我绕到塔影后头，再从另一侧出来。
lines.en: I slip behind the tower's shadow and out the far side.

lines.zh: 这条巡逻路我闭着眼也认得。
lines.en: I could walk this patrol route with my eyes shut.

lines.zh: 旗子一响，我就顺着风向走。
lines.en: When the banner snaps, I follow where the wind points.

lines.zh: 脚步不能停，停下就有人钻空子。
lines.en: I can't halt; a pause invites intruders in.

lines.zh: 我把剑换到右手，接着往前走。
lines.en: I shift my sword to my right hand and walk on.

lines.zh: 绿方的界线就在那道壕沟前面。
lines.en: The green line ends just before that ditch.

lines.zh: 我压低头盔，快步穿过空地。
lines.en: I lower my helm and hurry across the clearing.

lines.zh: 夯土路上没有回声，正好巡夜。
lines.en: Packed earth gives no echo — good for night rounds.

lines.zh: 前面有脚步，我先绕远看一圈。
lines.en: Footsteps ahead; I circle wide to take a look.

lines.zh: 站直了，别让人看出我累。
lines.en: Stand straight; don't let them see I'm tired.

lines.zh: 我把盾牌靠在膝边歇一会儿。
lines.en: I rest my shield against my knee a moment.

lines.zh: 盔沿遮着太阳，正好打个盹。
lines.en: My helm's brim shades the sun; perfect for a nap.

lines.zh: 风向变了，营火该往东边偏。
lines.en: The wind turned; the campfire will lean east now.

lines.zh: 我数着粮袋，一遍又一遍。
lines.en: I count the grain sacks, over and over.

lines.zh: 墙缝里有只蟋蟀，叫得比号角响。
lines.en: A cricket in the wall gap is louder than a horn.

lines.zh: 磨刀石挂在腰后，顺手蹭两下。
lines.en: My whetstone hangs behind me; I give it two passes.

lines.zh: 没有敌情的时候，时间走得真慢。
lines.en: With no enemy in sight, time crawls.

lines.zh: 我盯着壕沟，草动了一下又停。
lines.en: I watch the ditch; the grass stirs once, then stills.

lines.zh: 盔甲里闷得很，我掀开面罩透气。
lines.en: It's stifling in here; I lift my visor for air.

lines.zh: 同伴打了个哈欠，我也跟着困。
lines.en: My comrade yawns, and sleep catches me too.

lines.zh: 我重新系紧靴带，免得跑起来绊脚。
lines.en: I retie my bootlaces so they won't trip me.

lines.zh: 远处有乌鸦，落在哨塔横梁上。
lines.en: A crow lands on the watchtower beam far off.

lines.zh: 号角还早，我先靠着门柱站着。
lines.en: The horn is hours away; I lean on the gatepost.

lines.zh: 站住，报上名来，你是哪一方的？
lines.en: Halt. Name yourself — which side are you on?

lines.zh: 这身轻甲挡不住几剑，别试。
lines.en: This light armor won't stop many blades; don't test it.

lines.zh: 你的手离剑太近了，往后退。
lines.en: Your hand is too close to your sword. Back up.

lines.zh: 我在看你腰间挂了什么。
lines.en: I'm looking at what hangs from your belt.

lines.zh: 生面孔？营地里不常有生面孔。
lines.en: A new face? We don't get many in camp.

lines.zh: 你的靴子沾着红方的土。
lines.en: There's red-faction dirt on your boots.

lines.zh: 站那么近，是想挨我一剑吗？
lines.en: Standing that close — do you want my blade?

lines.zh: 你袖口露出的纹样，我没见过。
lines.en: That pattern at your cuff — I don't know it.

lines.zh: 把手举起来，慢慢转一圈。
lines.en: Hands up, and turn around slowly.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛在找什么，出口在那边。
lines.en: Your eyes are searching. The way out is there.

lines.zh: 我劝你别在夜里靠近营墙。
lines.en: I'd advise against nearing the wall at night.

lines.zh: 你身上的铁味，比商人重。
lines.en: You smell of iron — more than a trader would.

lines.zh: 我只问一句：你来做什么？
lines.en: One question only: what are you here for?

lines.zh: 你的呼吸很急，是跑来的吧。
lines.en: You're breathing hard. You ran here, didn't you?

lines.zh: 我在这儿守了三个月，没见过你。
lines.en: Three months on this post, and I've never seen you.

lines.zh: 再往前一步，我就拔剑了。
lines.en: One more step and my sword comes out.

lines.zh: 嘶，这一下打得我退了半步。
lines.en: Hiss — that blow put me half a step back.

lines.zh: 我的护腕挡住了大半。
lines.en: My bracer took most of it.

lines.zh: 绿旗还飘着，我就还没倒。
lines.en: The green banner still flies, so I am still standing.

lines.zh: 谁在背后放的冷箭？
lines.en: Who loosed that arrow from behind?

lines.zh: 咬紧牙关，头盔里只剩风声。
lines.en: Teeth clenched, with only wind inside my helmet.

lines.zh: 血从盔缝里渗出来了。
lines.en: Blood seeps through the seam of my helm.

lines.zh: 这一击让我握剑的手发麻。
lines.en: That hit numbed my sword hand.

lines.zh: 我喘了两口，重新举起剑。
lines.en: Two breaths, and I raise my sword again.

lines.zh: 别以为我会倒下。
lines.en: Don't think I'll go down.

lines.zh: 我扶着墙，慢慢站稳。
lines.en: I brace on the wall and steady myself.

lines.zh: 那袋金币？先放地上，别递过来。
lines.en: That purse of gold? Set it down, don't hand it over.

lines.zh: 一把好刀确实让人眼热。
lines.en: A good blade does make my eyes hot.

lines.zh: 你要是给我磨刀石，我或许听你说。
lines.en: Give me a whetstone and I might listen.

lines.zh: 我不缺面包，缺的是换岗的人。
lines.en: I don't lack bread; I lack a relief guard.

lines.zh: 战利品得分清楚，别想糊弄我。
lines.en: Loot gets divided properly. Don't try to cheat me.

lines.zh: 你腰上那把剑，卖不卖？
lines.en: That sword on your hip — is it for sale?

lines.zh: 我盯着那袋东西，不是因为饿。
lines.en: I'm staring at that sack, and it isn't hunger.

lines.zh: 别拿食物勾我，站岗时我不吃。
lines.en: Don't wave food at me; I don't eat on duty.

lines.zh: 一壶酒能换我一句好话，就一句。
lines.en: A flask of wine buys you one kind word. One.

lines.zh: 那枚徽章像是绿方的旧样式。
lines.en: That badge looks like an old green-faction design.

lines.zh: 撞什么，站岗的地方就这么宽。
lines.en: Watch where you shove; my post is only this wide.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的靴尖了。
lines.en: You stepped on the tip of my boot.

lines.zh: 别挤，盾牌会卡在门框上。
lines.en: Don't crowd me; my shield will jam in the doorway.

lines.zh: 我的剑鞘被你撞歪了。
lines.en: You knocked my scabbard crooked.

lines.zh: 退半步，我背后是墙。
lines.en: Half a step back — there's a wall behind me.

lines.zh: 你肩膀硬得像块石头。
lines.en: Your shoulder is hard as a stone block.

lines.zh: 走开点，盔甲碰响会惊动同伴。
lines.en: Move off; clanking armor will rouse the others.

lines.zh: 这一下把我头盔撞斜了。
lines.en: That knock set my helmet askew.

lines.zh: 别贴这么近，我以为你是红方的。
lines.en: Don't press so close; I took you for red.

lines.zh: 你踩到壕沟边的松土了，小心。
lines.en: You're on the loose soil at the ditch. Careful.

lines.zh: 这种事不该在岗上谈。
lines.en: This isn't a thing to discuss on watch.

lines.zh: 先守完这一班，别的不急。
lines.en: Let me finish this watch; the rest can wait.

lines.zh: 同伴之间只谈换岗和补给。
lines.en: Comrades talk of relief shifts and supplies.

lines.zh: 我的盔甲还没解开，你等等。
lines.en: My armor isn't off yet — wait.

lines.zh: 营墙外有动静，先别分心。
lines.en: Something's moving outside the wall; don't get distracted.

lines.zh: 现在不行，号角随时会响。
lines.en: Not now — the horn could sound any moment.

lines.zh: 我更想活着看到明天的太阳。
lines.en: I'd rather live to see tomorrow's sun.

lines.zh: 战友挤在一处，只为取暖。
lines.en: Soldiers huddle together only for warmth.

lines.zh: 你把剑放远点，再靠近些。
lines.en: Put your sword farther off, then come nearer.

lines.zh: 这话题在营里会传得很快。
lines.en: Word of this will race through camp.

lines.zh: 谁掉的扣环？我先收着。
lines.en: Whose buckle is this? I'll hold on to it.

lines.zh: 我捡起半截断箭，还有用。
lines.en: I pick up half an arrow; still useful.

lines.zh: 这枚铜币归公，交给军需官。
lines.en: This copper goes to the quartermaster.

lines.zh: 地上的面包硬了，还是能吃。
lines.en: The bread on the ground is stale, but edible.

lines.zh: 我拾起一块磨刀石，正缺这个。
lines.en: I pick up a whetstone — just what I needed.

lines.zh: 那把破剑我顺手拎起来了。
lines.en: I scoop up that battered sword too.

lines.zh: 有块布条，正好补我的护腕。
lines.en: A strip of cloth, just right for patching my bracer.

lines.zh: 我把掉落的东西塞进腰袋。
lines.en: I stuff the dropped things into my belt pouch.

lines.zh: 谁把钉子撒了一地？
lines.en: Who scattered nails all over the ground?

lines.zh: 这顶旧头盔比我的还新。
lines.en: This old helm is newer than mine.

lines.zh: 那边有人！我先喊一声。
lines.en: Someone's over there! I'll shout first.

lines.zh: 红方的旗，错不了。
lines.en: A red banner — no mistake.

lines.zh: 我看到你了，别躲在树后。
lines.en: I see you. Don't hide behind that tree.

lines.zh: 拔剑，我不打算再问第二遍。
lines.en: Draw your blade; I won't ask twice.

lines.zh: 有脚步声靠近营地了。
lines.en: Footsteps are nearing the camp.

lines.zh: 站住！你闯进绿方地界了。
lines.en: Halt! You've crossed into green territory.

lines.zh: 那身影一闪，我锁定了。
lines.en: A shape flickers past, and I've got it.

lines.zh: 敌袭，敲钟，快敲钟！
lines.en: Attack! Ring the bell — ring it now!

lines.zh: 我的剑已经出鞘一半。
lines.en: My sword is already half out.

lines.zh: 就是你，从壕沟那边翻过来的。
lines.en: You. You came over the ditch.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的步子转，别想绕后。
lines.en: I turn with your steps; no slipping behind me.

lines.zh: 你往后挪，我这双旧靴就跟上。
lines.en: You shuffle back; these worn boots follow.

lines.zh: 绿旗之下，我盯着你。
lines.en: Under the green banner, my eyes are on you.

lines.zh: 别往塔影里钻，我看得见。
lines.en: Don't dive into the tower's shadow; I can see.

lines.zh: 你呼吸乱了，我听得到。
lines.en: Your breathing's ragged. I can hear it.

lines.zh: 绕圈没用，我守的是直线。
lines.en: Circling won't help; I hold the straight line.

lines.zh: 你换一次方向，我就偏半寸。
lines.en: Every turn you make, I shift half an inch.

lines.zh: 我不喊了，喊也没用。
lines.en: I'll stop shouting; it does no good.

lines.zh: 盾牌举着，等你先动。
lines.en: Shield up. You move first.

lines.zh: 我们就这样耗着，看谁先累。
lines.en: We'll wear each other down and see who tires.

lines.zh: 吃我一剑，别躲。
lines.en: Take this blade — don't dodge.

lines.zh: 我劈向你的肩口。
lines.en: I cut down at your shoulder.

lines.zh: 剑锋带着风声落下去。
lines.en: The edge falls with a hiss of air.

lines.zh: 这一记是横斩，接住。
lines.en: This one's a side slash. Block it.

lines.zh: 别挡，你的木盾会断。
lines.en: Don't block; your wooden shield will split.

lines.zh: 我踩前半步，剑跟着刺出。
lines.en: I step in and thrust behind the blade.

lines.zh: 我的剑尖擦到你的护甲。
lines.en: My point scrapes across your armor.

lines.zh: 你退了，我追着补一下。
lines.en: You fall back; I follow with another cut.

lines.zh: 那一剑砍在你的手腕上。
lines.en: That one bit into your wrist.

lines.zh: 我收剑再劈，不给你喘息。
lines.en: I recover and swing again; no breath for you.

lines.zh: 号角响了，绿方列队。
lines.en: The horn sounds; green falls in.

lines.zh: 我从营帐里出来，剑已在手。
lines.en: I step from the tent with sword in hand.

lines.zh: 换上轻甲，我站在第二排。
lines.en: Light armor on, I take the second rank.

lines.zh: 旗手一挥，我从门后现身。
lines.en: The standard-bearer waves, and I come through the gate.

lines.zh: 谁在敲钟？我这就到位。
lines.en: Who rang the bell? I'm at my post.

lines.zh: 我从结构的长廊走到岗位。
lines.en: I walk the structure's corridor to my station.

lines.zh: 靴子上还沾着昨夜的泥。
lines.en: Last night's mud is still on my boots.

lines.zh: 铁匠刚把剑递给我，还热着。
lines.en: The smith just handed me this sword; it's still warm.

lines.zh: 阳光刺眼，我把面罩拉下来。
lines.en: The sun stings; I pull my visor down.

lines.zh: 队列还没散，我已经站好了。
lines.en: The ranks haven't dispersed, and I'm already set.

lines.zh: 火舌舔过护腕，铁烫得发红。
lines.en: Flames lick my bracer until the iron glows red.

lines.zh: 我从塔阶跌下来，腰撞上石棱。
lines.en: I tumble down the tower steps and crack my hip on stone.

lines.zh: 水灌进面罩，我硬扯下头盔。
lines.en: Water floods my visor; I wrench the helm off.

lines.zh: 爆风把我掀翻，耳朵嗡嗡响。
lines.en: The blast flips me over, ears ringing.

lines.zh: 一支箭钉进我的肩甲。
lines.en: An arrow buries itself in my shoulder plate.

lines.zh: 有股冷气钻进骨头，不是刀伤。
lines.en: Something cold creeps into my bones — no blade did this.

lines.zh: 干粮吃完了，我走路开始打晃。
lines.en: The rations are gone; my walk turns unsteady.

lines.zh: 雷劈在旗杆上，我半边身子发麻。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the flagpole; half my body goes numb.

lines.zh: 脚下没有地面，我一直往下掉。
lines.en: There's no ground beneath me, and I keep falling.
